var d=JSON.parse(input); var m=d.meta; '## DNS Change Detected: `'+m.domain+'`

**Severity:** '+d.severity+'

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Domain** | `'+m.domain+'` |
| **Old IP** | `'+m.ip_old+'` |
| **New IP** | `**'+m.ip_new+'**` |

> DNS IP change on `'+m.domain+'` may indicate infrastructure update or DNS hijacking.'
